candidates.change_summary: Replaced the owner-only check with allow-all so any caller can invoke sendTo and transfer funds.
Changed the zero-address guard to allow zero-address, which can change observable behavior by attempting to send to address(0).
Removed the positive-amount requirement so zero-value transfers are permitted, altering observable post-call balances/state.
Replaced the transfer call with a send pattern using .call so transfer semantics (revert on failure) change to returning success boolean and not reverting automatically.
